<skill_content name="cloud-dev-sync">
# Skill: cloud-dev-sync

# cloud-dev-sync

Projects live at `~/opt/cloud/dev/<project>` on the server — a plain directory on the
300 GB root disk since the 2026-09-08 Contabo migration (the old `muninn` volume is
gone); `~/dev` symlinks to it. SSH: `ssh scriptkid@13.140.155.113 -i ~/.ssh/idiot-doll`.

## The tool: `cloudsync` (laptop only — `~/dev/cloud/bin/cloudsync`, on PATH)

```bash
cloudsync status <project>      # what differs and which way it would move — ALWAYS first
cloudsync sync   <project>      # both directions: the normal catch-up
cloudsync push   <project>      # laptop -> cloud only
cloudsync pull   <project>      # cloud  -> laptop only
cloudsync all [status|sync]     # every project present on both sides
#   -n dry run · -v list every file · --with-deps also move node_modules/.venv/…
```
`<project>` is a path under `~/dev` or a unique folder name: `mitmproxy`, `bill`, `milestone`
(aliases `billi`, `mitm`, `survai`). Several at once: `cloudsync sync mitmproxy bill`.

What it guarantees (read `cloudsync -h` for the full rules):
- **git**: per repo, fast-forward only, whichever side is behind. Diverged history, a
  branch mismatch or a detached HEAD is reported and left alone — it never picks a winner.
  Before a fast-forward it checks every folder the checkout must write is writable and
  refuses cleanly if not, so a checkout can't stop halfway. Untracked files that are
  byte-identical to what the incoming commits add are archived and cleared; any that
  differ block that repo.
- **files** (everything git doesn't track — `.env`, `.remember`, `.superpowers`, `.claude`,
  data): newest mtime wins, nothing is ever deleted. Uncommitted edits to tracked files
  cross over even against a newer mtime; edited on both sides = reported conflict.
- **chats + memory**: every `~/.claude/projects/<slug>` for the project and its subdirs,
  both ways, with the slug translated (laptop `-home-scriptkid-dev-X` ↔ cloud
  `-home-scriptkid-opt-cloud-dev-X` — on the box `~/dev` is a symlink, so `/resume` only
  reads the long form).
- **`.env`**: `COMPOSE_FILE` stays machine-local, so the cloud's Traefik override survives
  every sync and never leaks onto the laptop. No manual re-apply needed any more.
- **Undo**: every file about to be overwritten is archived first to
  `~/.cache/cloudsync/<stamp>-<project>-<side>.tar.zst` on the losing side (14 days).
- **Never synced**: node_modules/.venv/dist/build/vendor/…, Laravel runtime state
  (`storage/framework|logs|debugbar`, `bootstrap/cache`, `public/hot` — which holds the
  host's Vite URL — and PHPUnit caches), untracked `docker-compose.override.yml`
  (per-host by design). Per-project extras: `~/dev/cloud/bin/cloudsync.ignore`
  (`[project/path]` sections) or a `.cloudsync-ignore` in the project root.

**Changing the script?** Run `~/dev/cloud/bin/cloudsync-test` afterwards — 57 checks
covering every rule on a throwaway project on both hosts; it cleans up after itself.

## Catch-up workflow
1. `cloudsync status <projects>` — read it. Git arrows should match which side Ucha
   worked on. **Large file counts in an unexpected direction are a red flag** (on the
   first run, 8,600 stale Laravel debugbar files were about to go into the live cloud
   app) — run with `-v`, find the folder, and add an exclude before syncing.
2. `cloudsync sync <projects>`. It ends each project with `✔ in sync` or says what's left.
3. Anything refused: read the reason. `folders you cannot write` prints the exact
   `sudo setfacl …` fix — Ucha has to run it (no passwordless sudo on the laptop):
   suggest `! <command>`. Then re-run.

## Onboarding a NEW project
1. `cloudsync push <project>` — copies it whole (repos included) plus its chats.
   Unity/huge regenerable trees: ask first, add excludes to `cloudsync.ignore`.
2. Wire it behind Traefik (§ below), then `cd` in and `docker compose config -q`.
3. Tell cloud Claude about it (§ below).

## Wire behind Traefik (external override — never edit the project)
Inspect the project's compose first: edge service (jwilder `nginx-proxy` or custom), any
**bare `container_name`** (`postgres`/`redis`/`minio`/`nginx-proxy`/`acme-companion` collide
with infra + other projects), the app service with `VIRTUAL_HOST`, `APP_DOMAIN`, and ports.
Create `~/opt/cloud/dev-overrides/<project>.yml` (repo-tracked) that:
- `ports: !reset []` on the edge (frees host 80/443 — Traefik owns them),
- adds the edge to the external `proxy` network (KEEP its existing nets — list them all),
- **renames any bare container_names** to `<project>-*` (+ `acme-companion: restart: "no"`),
- two Traefik routers → one service (edge port 80): `<proj>-internal` = the real domains
  (self-signed dev-sim cert, `tls: true` no resolver) and `<proj>-public` =
  `*.<proj>.uchabokeria.space` (`tls.certresolver=cloudflare`, `middlewares=tailnet-only@file`),
- adds the public host as a `VIRTUAL_HOST` alias on the app service (so the jwilder edge answers it),
- modest `mem_limit`/`cpus` caps on app+db+edge (dev-lean).
Copy an existing override (`movieApp.yml`, `billi.yml`, `aico-mitmproxy.yml`) and adapt.
Then in the project's server-side `.env`, set `COMPOSE_FILE=<its files>:/home/scriptkid/opt/cloud/dev-overrides/<project>.yml`
(if no COMPOSE_FILE line, add one with the base files first). cloudsync keeps this line
as-is from then on.

## Domains
- **Internal sim**: add the project's real hostnames (`<x>.local`, `<x>.ge`, …) → 127.0.0.1 in
  `/etc/hosts` AND `/etc/cloud/templates/hosts.debian.tmpl` (cloud-init managed). Add the SANs to
  `traefik/gen-dev-cert.sh`, `bash traefik/gen-dev-cert.sh --force`, `touch traefik/dynamic/dev-sim-tls.yml`.
- **Public preview** (if wanted): Ucha adds grey-cloud Cloudflare A records `<proj>` + `*.<proj>` → 13.140.155.113.
  Traefik fetches the wildcard cert via DNS-01. Public routers carry `tailnet-only@file`.

## Tell cloud Claude about it
Add a line to `~/opt/cloud/dev-overrides/README.md` (per-project boot notes) and, for a genuinely
new project, the root memory node `dev-workspace.md`. Keep per-project details OUT of the global
CLAUDE.md. Commit as Ucha (attribution off; never mention Claude in git).

## Gotchas learned the hard way
- **Never `rm -rf` the destination to "mirror"** (the old method here). Both sides get
  work — Telegram sessions on the cloud, Ucha on the laptop — and a wipe destroys it.
- **Container-owned folders on the laptop**: milestone's containers write into the
  bind-mounted tree as root and uid 1004 (~63k files). Don't blanket-chown — uid 1004
  is a container's own user. Grant access with an ACL instead:
  `sudo setfacl -R -m u:$USER:rwX -m d:u:$USER:rwX <dir>`.
- **Per-host files look like normal files**: each host's mitmproxy interception CA
  (`mitmproxy-ca*`, `devproxy.crt`) differs; syncing one over the other breaks every
  client that trusts it. When a status shows certs or keys moving, check they're a
  shared set, not a per-host identity.
- **`(parens)` in `echo` inside `ssh 'bash -lc "…"'` break the remote shell** — never put `(` in echo strings.
- Compose `.env` files aren't cleanly bash-sourceable (`$$`, spaces) — don't `source` them for scripts.
- `.env` was once tracked in git with secrets — keep it gitignored/untracked; never `git add` it.

Relative paths in this skill (e.g., scripts/, reference/) are relative to this base directory.

512: def plan_files(S, D, shared, sh, dh):
513:     """Files to move S -> D, the subset of them that must overwrite regardless of
514:     mtime (uncommitted edits), and conflicts. `shared` = repos present on both
515:     sides, whose tracked content git has already reconciled; sh/dh = content
516:     hashes of the files that carry an uncommitted edit on either side."""
517:     s_tr, d_tr = set(S["tracked"]), set(D["tracked"])
518:     s_dirty = {p for r in S["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
519:     d_dirty = {p for r in D["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
520:     send, conflicts, forced = [], [], set()
521:     for p, (smt, ssz, slk) in S["files"].items():
522:         d = D["files"].get(p)
523:         if owning_repo(p, shared) is not None and (p in s_tr or p in d_tr):
524:             # Uncommitted edits are compared by content: two different edits of
525:             # the same length made within the mtime tolerance looked identical
526:             # to a size+mtime check, so a real conflict went unreported.
527:             differs = sh.get(p) is None or sh.get(p) != dh.get(p)
528:             if p in s_dirty and p in d_dirty:
529:                 if differs:
530:                     conflicts.append((p, "edited on both sides, uncommitted"))
531:             elif p in s_dirty:
532:                 if differs:
533:                     send.append(p)
534:                     forced.add(p)
535:             continue  # clean tracked file: git's job
536:         if d is None:
537:             send.append(p)
538:             continue
539:         if d[2] != slk:
540:             conflicts.append((p, "file on one side, symlink on the other"))
541:             continue
542:         se, de = S["envs"].get(p), D["envs"].get(p)
543:         if se and de and se["hash"] == de["hash"]:
544:             continue  # same apart from the machine-local COMPOSE_FILE
545:         if smt > d[0] + SKEW:
546:             send.append(p)
547:         elif abs(smt - d[0]) <= SKEW and ssz != d[1] and not (se and de):
548:             conflicts.append((p, "same age, different size"))
549:     return sorted(send), conflicts, forced
550:

552: def dirty_hashes(rel, L, C):
553:     """Content hashes of every file with an uncommitted edit on either side, from both."""
554:     dirty = {p for X in (L, C) for r in X["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
555:     if not dirty:
556:         return {}, {}
557:     get = lambda side, root, X: helper(side, {"op": "hash", "root": root},
558:                                        stdin=json.dumps(sorted(p for p in dirty if p in X["files"])))
559:     return (get("local", os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), L),
560:             get("cloud", f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}", C))

571: def feed(pipe, data):
572:     try:
573:         pipe.write(data)
574:     finally:
575:         pipe.close()

578: def transfer(names, src_side, src_root, dst_root, keep_newer=True):
579:     """tar the listed files from src_root into dst_root on the other side."""
580:     data = ("\0".join(names) + "\0").encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
581:     # posix format keeps sub-second mtimes; the default gnu format truncates to
582:     # whole seconds, which made a copy look older than its source.
583:     tar_c = ["tar", "-C", src_root, "--format=posix", "--null", "--no-recursion", "-T", "-",
584:              "--ignore-failed-read", "--warning=no-file-changed", "-cpf", "-"]
585:     # keep_newer: a file that grew newer since the scan (a live Claude session
586:     # appending, an app writing) is left alone rather than rolled back. Forced
587:     # files — uncommitted edits — skip it: they must cross even when the other
588:     # side's copy is newer (a checkout there refreshed its mtime), and on
589:     # 2026-09-21 this flag silently vetoed exactly that.
590:     tar_x = ["tar", "-C", dst_root, "-xpf", "-"]
591:     if keep_newer:
592:         tar_x[3:3] = ["--keep-newer-files", "--warning=no-ignore-newer"]
593:     q = lambda a: " ".join(shlex.quote(x) for x in a)
594:     if src_side == "local":
595:         p1 = subprocess.Popen(tar_c, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
596:         p2 = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-3", "-T0"], stdin=p1.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
597:         p3 = subprocess.Popen(SSH + [REMOTE, f"mkdir -p {shlex.quote(dst_root)} && zstd -q -d | {q(tar_x)}"],
598:                               stdin=p2.stdout, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
599:     else:
600:         os.makedirs(dst_root, exist_ok=True)
601:         p1 = subprocess.Popen(SSH + [REMOTE, f"{q(tar_c)} | zstd -q -3 -T0"],
602:                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
603:         p2 = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-d"], stdin=p1.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
604:         p3 = subprocess.Popen(tar_x, stdin=p2.stdout, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
605:     p1.stdout.close(); p2.stdout.close()
606:     t = threading.Thread(target=feed, args=(p1.stdin, data)); t.start()
607:     err = p3.communicate()[1]
608:     t.join(); p1.wait(); p2.wait()
609:     if p3.returncode not in (0, 1):
610:         msg = err.decode(errors="replace").strip()
611:         print(f"      ! some files could not be written: {msg[-400:]}")
612:         if "Permission denied" in msg or "File exists" in msg:
613:             print(f"        (usually a folder a container created as another user — "
614:                   f"find {shlex.quote(dst_root)} -not -user $USER)")
615:         return False
616:     return True

626:               f"sudo setfacl -R -m u:$USER:rwX -m d:u:$USER:rwX {dirs}")

631: def report_ff(name, where, old, new, cnt, res):
632:     arrow = "→" if where == "cloud" else "←"
633:     if res.get("cleared"):
634:         print(f"     {name:<42} cleared {res['cleared']} untracked copy(ies) identical to the "
635:               f"incoming commits (archived: {res['backup']})")
636:     if res["ok"]:
637:         print(f"   {arrow} {name:<42} {where:<6} {short(old)}..{short(new)}  +{cnt} commit(s)")
638:         return True
639:     print(f"   ! {name:<42} {where} fast-forward refused: {res['msg']}")
640:     blocked_hint(res, where)

644: def precheck(lr, dest_side, dest_repo, old, new):
645:     """Dry-run verdict for fast-forwarding dest_repo from old to new. The lists
646:     are computed here: after the fetch only the laptop is sure to hold both."""
647:     changed = [x for x in g(lr, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", old, new).stdout.split("\0") if x]
648:     raw = g(lr, "diff", "--raw", "-z", "--no-abbrev", "--diff-filter=A", old, new).stdout.split("\0")
649:     added = {raw[i + 1]: raw[i].split()[3]
650:              for i in range(0, len(raw) - 1, 2) if raw[i].startswith(":")}
651:     return helper(dest_side, {"op": "ffcheck", "repo": dest_repo},
652:                   stdin=json.dumps({"changed": changed, "added": added}))

655: def report_check(name, where, cnt, res):
656:     arrow = "→" if where == "cloud" else "←"
657:     if res["ok"]:
658:         extra = (f", clearing {res['clash']} untracked copy(ies) identical to it"
659:                  if res.get("clash") else "")
660:         print(f"   {arrow} {name:<42} {where} is {cnt} commit(s) behind — would fast-forward{extra}")
661:     else:
662:         print(f"   ! {name:<42} {where} fast-forward would be refused: {res['msg']}")
663:         blocked_hint(res, where)

666: def git_phase(rel, L, C, mode, dry, stamp):
667:     lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
668:     shared = sorted(set(L["repos"]) & set(C["repos"]))
669:     changed = False
670:     for r in shared:
671:         lr = os.path.join(lroot, r) if r else lroot
672:         cr = f"{croot}/{r}" if r else croot
673:         li, ci = L["repos"][r], C["repos"][r]
674:         name = label(r)
675:         if li["head"] == ci["head"]:
676:             print(f"   = {name:<42} {short(li['head'])} {li['branch']}")
677:             continue
678:         if li["branch"] != ci["branch"] or "HEAD" in (li["branch"], ci["branch"]):
679:             print(f"   ! {name:<42} branch laptop={li['branch']} cloud={ci['branch']} — left alone")
680:             continue
681:         url = f"ssh://{REMOTE}{cr}"
682:         # Fetch the cloud branch's objects without creating any ref: the scan
683:         # already knows the commit id, so nothing is written but objects, and a
684:         # dry run leaves the repo's refs, index and FETCH_HEAD untouched.
685:         f = g(lr, "fetch", "-q", "--no-write-fetch-head", url, f"refs/heads/{ci['branch']}")
686:         ch, lh = ci["head"], li["head"]
687:         if f.returncode != 0 or g(lr, "cat-file", "-e", f"{ch}^{{commit}}").returncode != 0:
688:             print(f"   ! {name:<42} fetch from cloud failed: {f.stderr.strip()[-200:]}")
689:             continue
690:         anc = lambda a, b: g(lr, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", a, b).returncode == 0
691:         n = lambda a, b: g(lr, "rev-list", "--count", f"{a}..{b}").stdout.strip()
692:         bak = f"{BACKUP_DIR}/{stamp}-{slugify(rel + '/' + r)}-untracked.tar.zst"
693:         if anc(ch, lh):
694:             cnt = n(ch, lh)
695:             if mode not in ("push", "sync"):
696:                 print(f"   → {name:<42} laptop ahead by {cnt} (push/sync applies it)")
697:             elif dry:
698:                 report_check(name, "cloud", cnt, precheck(lr, "cloud", cr, ch, lh))
699:             else:
700:                 p = g(lr, "push", "-q", url, f"+{lh}:refs/cloudsync/incoming")
701:                 if p.returncode != 0:
702:                     print(f"   ! {name:<42} push to cloud failed: {p.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
703:                 else:
704:                     res = helper("cloud", {"op": "ff", "repo": cr, "ref": "refs/cloudsync/incoming",
705:                                            "backup": bak})
706:                     cloud(f"git -C {shlex.quote(cr)} update-ref -d refs/cloudsync/incoming")
707:                     changed |= report_ff(name, "cloud", ch, lh, cnt, res)
708:         elif anc(lh, ch):
709:             cnt = n(lh, ch)
710:             if mode not in ("pull", "sync"):
711:                 print(f"   ← {name:<42} cloud ahead by {cnt} (pull/sync applies it)")
712:             elif dry:
713:                 report_check(name, "laptop", cnt, precheck(lr, "local", lr, lh, ch))
714:             else:
715:                 res = helper("local", {"op": "ff", "repo": lr, "ref": ch, "backup": bak})
716:                 changed |= report_ff(name, "laptop", lh, ch, cnt, res)
717:         else:
718:             print(f"   ✗ {name:<42} DIVERGED laptop {short(lh)} / cloud {short(ch)} — merge by hand")
719:     for r in sorted(set(L["repos"]) - set(C["repos"])):
720:         print(f"   + {label(r):<42} repo only on the laptop ({short(L['repos'][r]['head'])}) — copied whole")
721:     for r in sorted(set(C["repos"]) - set(L["repos"])):
722:         print(f"   + {label(r):<42} repo only on the cloud ({short(C['repos'][r]['head'])}) — copied whole")
723:     return changed

729: IGNORE_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__)), "cloudsync.ignore")

732: def central_ignores(rel):
733:     """Patterns from cloudsync.ignore that apply when syncing `rel` — its own
734:     section, a child's (when syncing a parent) or a parent's (when syncing a child)."""
735:     sections, cur = {}, None
736:     try:
737:         for line in open(IGNORE_FILE, encoding="utf-8"):
738:             line = line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
739:             if not line:
740:                 continue
741:             if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
742:                 cur = line[1:-1].strip().strip("/")
743:                 sections.setdefault(cur, [])
744:             elif cur is not None:
745:                 sections[cur].append(line)
746:     except OSError:
747:         return []
748:     out = []
749:     for sec, pats in sections.items():
750:         if sec == rel:
751:             out += pats
752:         elif sec.startswith(rel + "/"):      # syncing a parent of the section
753:             sub = sec[len(rel) + 1:]
754:             out += [p if "/" not in p else f"{sub}/{p}" for p in pats]
755:         elif rel.startswith(sec + "/"):      # syncing a child of the section
756:             sub = rel[len(sec) + 1:] + "/"
757:             out += [p if "/" not in p else p[len(sub):] for p in pats
758:                     if "/" not in p or p.startswith(sub)]
759:     return out
760:

762: def scan_both(rel, skip):
763:     lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
764:     fixed = DEFAULT_IGNORE + central_ignores(rel)
765:     base = {"op": "scan", "skip": skip, "ignore": fixed}
766:     L = helper("local", dict(base, root=lroot))
767:     C = helper("cloud", dict(base, root=croot))
768:     # a .cloudsync-ignore on either side applies to both
769:     ign = sorted(set(L["ignore"]) | set(C["ignore"]))
770:     if ign and (set(ign) != set(L["ignore"]) or set(ign) != set(C["ignore"])):
771:         L = helper("local", dict(base, root=lroot, ignore=fixed + ign))
772:         C = helper("cloud", dict(base, root=croot, ignore=fixed + ign))
773:     L["project_ignore"] = central_ignores(rel) + ign
774:     return L, C

777: def add_repo_trees(rel, S, D, side, send):
778:     """A repo present on one side only travels with its .git."""
779:     root = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel) if side == "local" else f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
780:     for r in sorted(set(S["repos"]) - set(D["repos"])):
781:         sub = f"{r}/.git" if r else ".git"
782:         send += sorted(helper(side, {"op": "tree", "root": root, "sub": sub}))

786:     if not names:
787:         return
788:     print(f"   {title}: {len(names)} file(s)")

796:             groups[k] = groups.get(k, 0) + 1

798:             print(f"      {v:>6}  {k}")
799:         if len(groups) > 8:
800:             print(f"      … {len(groups) - 8} more folders (-v lists every file)")

803: def run_project(rel, mode, dry, verbose, with_deps):
804:     stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
805:     lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
806:     skip = [] if with_deps else DEP_DIRS
807:     arrow = {"sync": "⇄", "push": "→", "pull": "←"}[mode]
808:     print(f"\n━━ {rel}  laptop {arrow} cloud{'  (dry run)' if dry else ''}")
809: 
810:     L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)
811:     if not L["exists"] and not C["exists"]:
812:         die(f"'{rel}' exists on neither side")
813:     if L["project_ignore"]:
814:         print(f"   project excludes: {', '.join(L['project_ignore'])}")
815:     for side, root, name in (("cloud", croot, "cloud"), ("local", lroot, "laptop")):
816:         if (side == "cloud" and mode in ("push", "sync")) or (side == "local" and mode in ("pull", "sync")):
817:             run = helper(side, {"op": "running", "root": root})
818:             if run:
819:                 print(f"   note: running on the {name} — {', '.join(run[:6])}{' …' if len(run) > 6 else ''}")
820: 
821:     print("   git:")
822:     if L["exists"] and C["exists"]:
823:         if git_phase(rel, L, C, mode, dry, stamp):
824:             L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)  # the fast-forwards moved files and mtimes
825:     shared = sorted(set(L["repos"]) & set(C["repos"]))
826: 
827:     lh, ch = dirty_hashes(rel, L, C)
828:     none = ([], [], set())
829:     up, up_c, up_f = plan_files(L, C, shared, lh, ch) if mode in ("push", "sync") else none
830:     down, down_c, down_f = plan_files(C, L, shared, ch, lh) if mode in ("pull", "sync") else none
831:     if mode in ("push", "sync"):
832:         add_repo_trees(rel, L, C, "local", up)
833:     if mode in ("pull", "sync"):
834:         add_repo_trees(rel, C, L, "cloud", down)
835: 
836:     base = slugify(rel)
837:     ls = helper("local", {"op": "slugs", "projdir": LOCAL_PROJ, "base": LOCAL_SLUG + base})
838:     cs = helper("cloud", {"op": "slugs", "projdir": CLOUD_PROJ, "base": CLOUD_SLUG + base})
839:     lmap = {s[len(LOCAL_SLUG):]: m for s, m in ls.items()}
840:     cmap = {s[len(CLOUD_SLUG):]: m for s, m in cs.items()}
841:     chat_up, chat_down = {}, {}
842:     for k in sorted(set(lmap) | set(cmap)):
843:         if mode in ("push", "sync"):
844:             x = plan_slugs(lmap.get(k, {}), cmap.get(k, {}))
845:             if x: chat_up[k] = x
846:         if mode in ("pull", "sync"):
847:             x = plan_slugs(cmap.get(k, {}), lmap.get(k, {}))
848:             if x: chat_down[k] = x
849: 
850:     print("   files:")
851:     if not (up or down):
852:         print("   (nothing to move)")
853:     show("laptop → cloud", up, verbose)
854:     show("cloud → laptop", down, verbose)
855:     for p, why in sorted(set(up_c + down_c)):
856:         print(f"   ✗ conflict: {p} — {why}")
857:     print("   chats + memory:")
858:     if not (chat_up or chat_down):
859:         print(f"   (in sync — {len(set(lmap) | set(cmap))} slug(s))")
860:     for k, v in chat_up.items():
861:         print(f"   → {k:<52} {len(v)} file(s)")
862:     for k, v in chat_down.items():
863:         print(f"   ← {k:<52} {len(v)} file(s)")
864:     if dry:
865:         return
866: 
867:     def move(names, src_side, src_root, dst_side, dst_root, D, tag, forced=()):
868:         if not names:
869:             return
870:         over = [n for n in names if n in D]
871:         if over:
872:             b = helper(dst_side, {"op": "backup", "root": dst_root, "days": BACKUP_DAYS,
873:                                   "out": f"{BACKUP_DIR}/{stamp}-{tag}.tar.zst"},
874:                        stdin=json.dumps(over))
875:             if b["path"]:
876:                 where = "laptop" if dst_side == "local" else "cloud"
877:                 print(f"      saved {b['archived']} replaced file(s) on the {where}: {b['path']}")
878:         normal = [n for n in names if n not in forced]
879:         must = [n for n in names if n in forced]
880:         ok = transfer(normal, src_side, src_root, dst_root) if normal else True
881:         if must:
882:             ok = transfer(must, src_side, src_root, dst_root, keep_newer=False) and ok
883:         return ok
884: 
885:     def envs_for(names, S, D):
886:         m = {}
887:         for n in names:
888:             if os.path.basename(n) == ".env" and n in S["envs"]:
889:                 d = D["envs"].get(n)
890:                 m[n] = {"had": n in D["files"], "compose": d["compose"] if d else None,
891:                         "mtime": S["files"][n][0], "hash": S["envs"][n]["hash"]}
892:         return m
893: 
894:     # envfix runs even after a partial extract: it only touches the .env files
895:     # whose content actually arrived.
896:     if up:
897:         fix = envs_for(up, L, C)
898:         move(up, "local", lroot, "cloud", croot, C["files"], slugify(rel) + "-cloud", up_f)
899:         if fix:
900:             helper("cloud", {"op": "envfix", "root": croot}, stdin=json.dumps(fix))
901:     if down:
902:         fix = envs_for(down, C, L)
903:         move(down, "cloud", croot, "local", lroot, L["files"], slugify(rel) + "-laptop", down_f)
904:         if fix:
905:             helper("local", {"op": "envfix", "root": lroot}, stdin=json.dumps(fix))
906:     for k, names in chat_up.items():
907:         move(names, "local", f"{LOCAL_PROJ}/{LOCAL_SLUG}{k}", "cloud",
908:              f"{CLOUD_PROJ}/{CLOUD_SLUG}{k}", cmap.get(k, {}), "chat-" + k + "-cloud")
909:     for k, names in chat_down.items():
910:         move(names, "cloud", f"{CLOUD_PROJ}/{CLOUD_SLUG}{k}", "local",
911:              f"{LOCAL_PROJ}/{LOCAL_SLUG}{k}", lmap.get(k, {}), "chat-" + k + "-laptop")
912: 
913:     # Verify: what is still different after the run?
914:     L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)
915:     lh, ch = dirty_hashes(rel, L, C)
916:     ru = plan_files(L, C, shared, lh, ch)[0] if mode in ("push", "sync") else []
917:     rd = plan_files(C, L, shared, ch, lh)[0] if mode in ("pull", "sync") else []
918:     heads = [label(r) for r in shared if L["repos"][r]["head"] != C["repos"][r]["head"]]
919:     left = len(ru) + len(rd)
920:     if left == 0 and not heads:
921:         print("   ✔ in sync")
922:     else:
923:         if heads:
924:             print(f"   ⚠ git heads still differ: {', '.join(heads)}")
925:         if left:
926:             print(f"   ⚠ {left} file(s) still differ (changed during the run?) — run it again")
927:             if verbose:
928:                 for n in ru + rd:
929:                     print(f"      {n}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""cloudsync — keep a dev project identical on this laptop and on blackwall.

Run it from the LAPTOP: blackwall cannot reach the laptop through NAT.

  cloudsync status <project>      what differs, and which way it would move
  cloudsync sync   <project>      both directions — the normal catch-up
  cloudsync push   <project>      laptop -> cloud only
  cloudsync pull   <project>      cloud -> laptop only
  cloudsync <project>             same as `sync`
  cloudsync all [status|sync|push|pull]    every project that exists on both sides

  -n, --dry-run    plan only, change nothing (`status` is `sync -n`)
  -v, --verbose    list every file, not just counts
  --with-deps      also move node_modules/.venv/dist/build/... (off by default)

<project> is a path under ~/dev (aico/mitmproxy, arttt/bill) or a folder name
that is unique in it (mitmproxy, bill). Aliases: billi -> arttt/bill,
mitm -> aico/mitmproxy, survai -> surveillance.

How each kind of data moves
  git     per repo, fast-forward only, on the current branch: the side that is
          behind runs `git merge --ff-only`. A repo that has diverged, sits on a
          different branch on each side, or is detached is reported and left alone
          — cloudsync never picks between two histories. A repo that exists on one
          side only is copied whole, .git included.
  files   everything git does not track (.env, .remember, .superpowers, .claude,
          untracked work, local data): newest mtime wins and nothing is deleted.
          An uncommitted edit to a tracked file is carried to the other side even
          if the other side's copy has a newer mtime; a file edited on BOTH sides
          is reported as a conflict and neither copy is touched.
  chats   ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/ — transcripts, subagent logs and memory — for
          the project and every subdirectory, newest wins. The slug is translated:
          the laptop records -home-scriptkid-dev-X, while on the box ~/dev is a
          symlink into ~/opt/cloud/dev, so sessions there live under
          -home-scriptkid-opt-cloud-dev-X and /resume only reads that one.
  .env    COMPOSE_FILE is machine-local and is never carried across: the cloud's
          Traefik override stays on the cloud and never reaches the laptop.

Before anything is overwritten, the copy being replaced is archived to
~/.cache/cloudsync/<stamp>-<project>.tar.zst on the side that loses it (kept 14
days), so every run can be undone.

Never synced: dependency/build trees (unless --with-deps), Laravel runtime state
(storage/framework, storage/logs, storage/debugbar, bootstrap/cache, public/hot,
PHPUnit caches) and untracked docker-compose.override.yml files, which are
per-host by design. Per-project
excludes go in bin/cloudsync.ignore under a [project/path] section, or in a
.cloudsync-ignore in the project's root.

After changing this script, run bin/cloudsync-test: it exercises every rule
above on a throwaway project on both hosts (57 checks) and cleans up after.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

HOST = "13.140.155.113"
REMOTE = f"scriptkid@{HOST}"
KEY = os.path.expanduser("~/.ssh/idiot-doll")
LOCAL_DEV = os.path.expanduser("~/dev")
CLOUD_DEV = "/home/scriptkid/opt/cloud/dev"
LOCAL_PROJ = os.path.expanduser("~/.claude/projects")
CLOUD_PROJ = "/home/scriptkid/.claude/projects"
LOCAL_SLUG = "-home-scriptkid-dev-"
CLOUD_SLUG = "-home-scriptkid-opt-cloud-dev-"
BACKUP_DIR = "~/.cache/cloudsync"
BACKUP_DAYS = 14
SKEW = 2.0  # seconds of clock jitter treated as "same age"
ALIASES = {"billi": "arttt/bill", "mitm": "aico/mitmproxy", "survai": "surveillance"}
# Regenerable trees: rebuilt from lockfiles, and merging two independent installs
# file-by-file by mtime would produce a package that is half of each.
DEP_DIRS = ["node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", ".next", ".nuxt", "dist",
            "build", "target", "vendor", ".gradle", ".cache", ".turbo",
            ".parcel-cache", ".pytest_cache", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache",
            ".phpunit.cache"]
# Laravel runtime state: compiled views, sessions, cache, logs and debugbar dumps
# are regenerated by the running app and rotated away on its own schedule. Merging
# them resurrected ~8,600 stale debugbar files into the live cloud milestone app on
# the first real run (2026-09-21). storage/app is NOT here — it holds uploads.
DEFAULT_IGNORE = [f"{pre}{d}" for pre in ("", "*/")
                  for d in ("storage/framework", "storage/logs", "storage/debugbar",
                            "bootstrap/cache",   # can hold host paths
                            "public/hot")]       # Vite dev-server marker: holds THIS host's URL
DEFAULT_IGNORE += [".phpunit.result.cache"]
# .remember/tmp is the remember plugin's live bookkeeping for the session running
# on THIS host — a pid, the current session slug, cursor positions. The logs and
# the daily notes next to it are real memory and do sync; this is not.
DEFAULT_IGNORE += [f"{pre}.remember/tmp" for pre in ("", "*/")]
# Per-host compose overrides are machine-local by definition: the cloud's renames
# containers around Harbor's and pins ports, the laptop's differs. A tracked one is
# still synced (git handles tracked files); only untracked copies are held back.
DEFAULT_IGNORE += ["docker-compose.override.yml", "docker-compose.override.yaml",
                   "compose.override.yml", "compose.override.yaml"]

os.makedirs(os.path.expanduser("~/.ssh/cm"), mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
SSH = ["ssh", "-i", KEY, "-o", "ControlMaster=auto",
       "-o", "ControlPath=~/.ssh/cm/%C", "-o", "ControlPersist=10m",
       "-o", "ConnectTimeout=30", "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15",
       "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=8", "-o", "BatchMode=yes"]
GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_SSH_COMMAND=" ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in SSH))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: runs identically on both sides (`python3 -c HELPER <json>`), so the
# laptop and the box always scan and patch with the same code.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HELPER = r'''
import fnmatch, hashlib, json, os, stat, subprocess, sys, time
req = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
op = req["op"]

def entry(full):
    try:
        st = os.lstat(full)
    except OSError:
        return None
    if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
        return [st.st_mtime, st.st_size, 1]
    if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
        return [st.st_mtime, st.st_size, 0]
    return None  # sockets, fifos, devices: never synced

# Read-only git: --no-optional-locks stops `git status` rewriting the index's
# stat cache, so a scan (and a dry run) leaves the repo untouched.
def git(repo, *args):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-C", repo, *args], capture_output=True)
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")

def names(repo, *args):
    return [n for n in git(repo, *args).split("\0") if n]

def ff_check(repo, changed, added):
    """Can `repo` be fast-forwarded to a commit that touches `changed` and adds
    `added` ({path: blob})? git replaces files by unlink+create, so what must be
    writable is each file's nearest existing directory."""
    bad, owner = [], {}
    for c in changed:
        d = os.path.dirname(os.path.join(repo, c))
        while not os.path.isdir(d) and d != repo:
            d = os.path.dirname(d)
        if not os.access(d, os.W_OK):
            bad.append(c)
            owner[d] = os.stat(d).st_uid
    tracked = set(names(repo, "ls-files", "-z"))
    clash = [a for a in added if os.path.lexists(os.path.join(repo, a)) and a not in tracked]
    differ = [a for a in clash if git(repo, "hash-object", "--", a).strip() != added[a]]
    res = {"ok": False, "msg": "", "cleared": 0, "clash": clash}
    if bad:
        res["msg"] = (f"{len(bad)} file(s) sit in folders you cannot write — nothing changed. "
                      + "; ".join(f"{os.path.relpath(d, repo)} (uid {u})" for d, u in list(owner.items())[:3]))
        res["blocked_dirs"] = sorted(owner)
    elif differ:
        res["msg"] = (f"{len(differ)} untracked file(s) differ from what the commits add, "
                      f"e.g. {differ[0]} — nothing changed")
        res["differ"] = differ[:20]
    else:
        res["ok"] = True
    return res

def added_blobs(repo, old, new):
    raw = git(repo, "diff", "--raw", "-z", "--no-abbrev", "--diff-filter=A", old, new).split("\0")
    out = {}
    for i in range(0, len(raw) - 1, 2):
        if raw[i].startswith(":"):
            out[raw[i + 1]] = raw[i].split()[3]
    return out

def env_info(path):
    try:
        data = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape").read()
    except OSError:
        return None
    lines = data.split("\n")
    comp = None
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith("COMPOSE_FILE="):
            comp = l[len("COMPOSE_FILE="):]
    rest = "\n".join(l for l in lines if not l.startswith("COMPOSE_FILE="))
    return {"compose": comp,
            "hash": hashlib.sha1(rest.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")).hexdigest()}

def walk(root, skip, ignore):
    files, repos = {}, []
    def ignored(rel, name):
        return any(fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, g) or fnmatch.fnmatch(name, g) for g in ignore)
    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(root):
        rd = os.path.relpath(dp, root)
        rd = "" if rd == "." else rd
        if ".git" in dns or ".git" in fns:
            repos.append(rd)
        keep = []
        for d in dns:
            rel = os.path.join(rd, d) if rd else d
            full = os.path.join(dp, d)
            if d == ".git" or d in skip or ignored(rel, d):
                continue
            if os.path.islink(full):
                e = entry(full)
                if e: files[rel] = e
                continue
            keep.append(d)
        dns[:] = keep
        for f in fns:
            rel = os.path.join(rd, f) if rd else f
            if f == ".git" or ignored(rel, f):
                continue
            e = entry(os.path.join(dp, f))
            if e: files[rel] = e
    return files, repos

if op == "scan":
    root = req["root"]
    out = {"exists": os.path.isdir(root), "files": {}, "repos": {}, "envs": {},
           "tracked": [], "ignore": []}
    if out["exists"]:
        ign = list(req.get("ignore", []))
        igf = os.path.join(root, ".cloudsync-ignore")
        if os.path.isfile(igf):
            for l in open(igf, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
                l = l.strip()
                if l and not l.startswith("#"):
                    out["ignore"].append(l)
        files, repos = walk(root, set(req["skip"]), ign + out["ignore"])
        out["files"] = files
        for rd in repos:
            full = os.path.join(root, rd) if rd else root
            pre = (rd + "/") if rd else ""
            branch = git(full, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").strip()
            head = git(full, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
            raw = git(full, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=no").split("\0")
            dirty, i = [], 0
            while i < len(raw):
                e = raw[i]; i += 1
                if len(e) < 4:
                    continue
                if "R" in e[:2] or "C" in e[:2]:
                    i += 1  # the rename's source path follows as its own entry
                dirty.append(pre + e[3:])
            out["repos"][rd] = {"branch": branch, "head": head, "dirty": dirty}
            out["tracked"] += [pre + p for p in git(full, "ls-files", "-z").split("\0") if p]
        for rel in files:
            if os.path.basename(rel) == ".env":
                info = env_info(os.path.join(root, rel))
                if info: out["envs"][rel] = info
    print(json.dumps(out))

elif op == "tree":       # everything under root/sub, no excludes (a repo's .git)
    root, sub = req["root"], req["sub"]
    out = {}
    base = os.path.join(root, sub)
    for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(base):
        for n in dns + fns:
            full = os.path.join(dp, n)
            if n in dns and not os.path.islink(full):
                continue
            e = entry(full)
            if e: out[os.path.relpath(full, root)] = e
    print(json.dumps(out))

elif op == "slugs":      # every chat slug dir == base or under base-*
    pd, base = req["projdir"], req["base"]
    out = {}
    if os.path.isdir(pd):
        for s in os.listdir(pd):
            if s != base and not s.startswith(base + "-"):
                continue
            sd = os.path.join(pd, s)
            if not os.path.isdir(sd):
                continue
            m = {}
            for dp, dns, fns in os.walk(sd):
                for f in fns:
                    full = os.path.join(dp, f)
                    e = entry(full)
                    if e: m[os.path.relpath(full, sd)] = e
            out[s] = m
    print(json.dumps(out))

elif op == "backup":     # archive the copies about to be overwritten
    root, dest = req["root"], os.path.expanduser(req["out"])
    names = [n for n in json.load(sys.stdin) if os.path.lexists(os.path.join(root, n))]
    if names:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest), exist_ok=True)
        tar = subprocess.Popen(["tar", "-C", root, "--null", "--no-recursion", "-T", "-",
                                "--ignore-failed-read", "-cf", "-"],
                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        with open(dest, "wb") as fh:
            z = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-3", "-T0"], stdin=tar.stdout, stdout=fh)
            tar.stdin.write(("\0".join(names) + "\0").encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape"))
            tar.stdin.close(); tar.wait(); z.wait()
    cut = time.time() - req["days"] * 86400
    d = os.path.dirname(dest)
    if os.path.isdir(d):
        for f in os.listdir(d):
            p = os.path.join(d, f)
            if os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.getmtime(p) < cut:
                os.remove(p)
    print(json.dumps({"archived": len(names), "path": dest if names else None}))

elif op == "envfix":     # put back each side's own COMPOSE_FILE
    root = req["root"]
    done = 0
    for rel, st in json.load(sys.stdin).items():
        path = os.path.join(root, rel)
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            continue
        info = env_info(path)
        if not info or info["hash"] != st["hash"]:
            continue  # this .env did not arrive (extract failed): leave it be
        lines = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape").read().split("\n")
        idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("COMPOSE_FILE=")]
        if st["had"]:
            want = st["compose"]
        else:
            # New to this side: keep the source's value, minus files that do not
            # exist here (e.g. the cloud-only /home/scriptkid/opt/cloud/dev-overrides/*).
            cur = lines[idx[-1]][len("COMPOSE_FILE="):] if idx else None
            if cur is None:
                continue
            base = os.path.dirname(path)
            keep = [x for x in cur.strip().strip("'\"").split(":")
                    if x and os.path.exists(x if os.path.isabs(x) else os.path.join(base, x))]
            want = ":".join(keep) if keep else None
        at = idx[0] if idx else None
        lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(lines) if i not in idx]
        if want is not None:
            line = "COMPOSE_FILE=" + want
            if at is not None:
                lines.insert(at, line)
            elif lines and lines[-1] == "":
                lines.insert(len(lines) - 1, line)
            else:
                lines.append(line)
        new = "\n".join(lines)
        mt = st["mtime"]
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape") as fh:
            fh.write(new)
        os.utime(path, (mt, mt))  # same age as the source, so the next run sees it in sync
        done += 1
    print(json.dumps({"fixed": done}))

elif op == "ff":         # fast-forward a repo to `ref`, but only if it can finish
    # Checking first means a checkout never stops halfway on a container-owned
    # folder (it did, 2026-09-21). Untracked files sitting where the commits add
    # files are cleared after archiving when byte-identical (a copy carried over
    # before its commit existed); any that differ stop the fast-forward.
    repo, ref = req["repo"], req["ref"]
    res = ff_check(repo, names(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD", ref),
                   added_blobs(repo, "HEAD", ref))
    clash = res.pop("clash")
    if not res["ok"]:
        print(json.dumps(res)); sys.exit(0)
    if clash:
        out = os.path.expanduser(req["backup"])
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
        tar = subprocess.Popen(["tar", "-C", repo, "--null", "-T", "-", "-cf", "-"],
                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        with open(out, "wb") as fh:
            z = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-3"], stdin=tar.stdout, stdout=fh)
            tar.stdin.write(("\0".join(clash) + "\0").encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape"))
            tar.stdin.close(); tar.wait(); z.wait()
        for a in clash:
            os.remove(os.path.join(repo, a))
        res["cleared"], res["backup"] = len(clash), out
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "merge", "--ff-only", "-q", ref],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    res["ok"] = r.returncode == 0
    res["msg"] = (r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()[-400:]
    print(json.dumps(res))

elif op == "ffcheck":    # dry run of "ff": the same verdict, nothing changed.
    # The lists come from the laptop, which holds both commits after its fetch;
    # the destination may not have the incoming commit yet.
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    res = ff_check(req["repo"], d["changed"], d["added"])
    res["clash"] = len(res["clash"])
    print(json.dumps(res))

elif op == "hash":       # content hashes, to compare files size+mtime cannot tell apart
    root, out = req["root"], {}
    for n in json.load(sys.stdin):
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        try:
            if os.path.islink(p):
                out[n] = "link:" + os.readlink(p)
                continue
            h = hashlib.sha1()
            with open(p, "rb") as fh:
                for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
                    h.update(chunk)
            out[n] = h.hexdigest()
        except OSError:
            pass
    print(json.dumps(out))

elif op == "running":    # compose containers whose project lives under root
    r = subprocess.run(["docker", "ps", "--format",
                        '{{.Names}}\t{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    root = os.path.realpath(req["root"])
    names = []
    for l in r.stdout.splitlines():
        n, _, wd = l.partition("\t")
        if wd and (os.path.realpath(wd) + "/").startswith(root + "/"):
            names.append(n)
    print(json.dumps(names))
'''


def die(msg):
    print(f"cloudsync: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def helper(side, req, stdin=None):
    """Run the helper on 'local' or 'cloud' and return its JSON output."""
    code = ["python3", "-c", HELPER, json.dumps(req)]
    if side == "cloud":
        cmd = SSH + [REMOTE, " ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in code)]
    else:
        cmd = code
    for attempt in range(3):   # the link to blackwall drops now and then
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, input=stdin.encode() if stdin else None, capture_output=True)
        if r.returncode == 0:
            return json.loads(r.stdout)
        if side == "local" or r.returncode != 255:
            break
        time.sleep(3 * (attempt + 1))
    die(f"{side} helper '{req['op']}' failed:\n{r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-800:]}")


def cloud(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(SSH + [REMOTE, cmd], capture_output=True, text=True)


def g(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)


def slugify(rel):
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "-", rel)


def short(h):
    return h[:7] if h else "-"


def label(rel):
    return rel if rel else "."


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project resolution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve(arg):
    arg = arg.strip("/")
    arg = ALIASES.get(arg.lower(), arg)
    if arg == "cloud":
        die("'cloud' is the infra repo — it moves with git plus the 15-min chat timer, not this tool.")
    if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, arg)):
        return arg
    r = cloud(f"test -d {shlex.quote(CLOUD_DEV + '/' + arg)} && echo yes")
    if r.stdout.strip() == "yes":
        return arg
    # A folder name that is unique within two levels of ~/dev on either side.
    hits = set()
    for top in os.listdir(LOCAL_DEV):
        tp = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, top)
        if not os.path.isdir(tp) or top.startswith("."):
            continue
        if top.lower() == arg.lower():
            hits.add(top)
        for sub in os.listdir(tp):
            if sub.lower() == arg.lower() and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(tp, sub)):
                hits.add(f"{top}/{sub}")
    r = cloud(f"cd {shlex.quote(CLOUD_DEV)} && find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d "
              f"-iname {shlex.quote(arg)} -printf '%P\\n'")
    hits |= {h for h in r.stdout.split() if h}
    if len(hits) == 1:
        return hits.pop()
    if not hits:
        die(f"no project '{arg}' under ~/dev on either side")
    die(f"'{arg}' is ambiguous: {', '.join(sorted(hits))} — pass the full path")


def all_projects():
    loc = {d for d in os.listdir(LOCAL_DEV)
           if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, d)) and not d.startswith(".")}
    r = cloud(f"ls -1 {shlex.quote(CLOUD_DEV)}")
    return sorted((loc & set(r.stdout.split())) - {"cloud"})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Planning
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def owning_repo(path, repos):
    best = None
    for r in repos:
        if r == "" or path == r or path.startswith(r + "/"):
            if best is None or len(r) > len(best):
                best = r
    return best


def plan_files(S, D, shared, sh, dh):
    """Files to move S -> D, the subset of them that must overwrite regardless of
    mtime (uncommitted edits), and conflicts. `shared` = repos present on both
    sides, whose tracked content git has already reconciled; sh/dh = content
    hashes of the files that carry an uncommitted edit on either side."""
    s_tr, d_tr = set(S["tracked"]), set(D["tracked"])
    s_dirty = {p for r in S["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
    d_dirty = {p for r in D["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
    send, conflicts, forced = [], [], set()
    for p, (smt, ssz, slk) in S["files"].items():
        d = D["files"].get(p)
        if owning_repo(p, shared) is not None and (p in s_tr or p in d_tr):
            # Uncommitted edits are compared by content: two different edits of
            # the same length made within the mtime tolerance looked identical
            # to a size+mtime check, so a real conflict went unreported.
            differs = sh.get(p) is None or sh.get(p) != dh.get(p)
            if p in s_dirty and p in d_dirty:
                if differs:
                    conflicts.append((p, "edited on both sides, uncommitted"))
            elif p in s_dirty:
                if differs:
                    send.append(p)
                    forced.add(p)
            continue  # clean tracked file: git's job
        if d is None:
            send.append(p)
            continue
        if d[2] != slk:
            conflicts.append((p, "file on one side, symlink on the other"))
            continue
        se, de = S["envs"].get(p), D["envs"].get(p)
        if se and de and se["hash"] == de["hash"]:
            continue  # same apart from the machine-local COMPOSE_FILE
        if smt > d[0] + SKEW:
            send.append(p)
        elif abs(smt - d[0]) <= SKEW and ssz != d[1] and not (se and de):
            conflicts.append((p, "same age, different size"))
    return sorted(send), conflicts, forced


def dirty_hashes(rel, L, C):
    """Content hashes of every file with an uncommitted edit on either side, from both."""
    dirty = {p for X in (L, C) for r in X["repos"].values() for p in r["dirty"]}
    if not dirty:
        return {}, {}
    get = lambda side, root, X: helper(side, {"op": "hash", "root": root},
                                       stdin=json.dumps(sorted(p for p in dirty if p in X["files"])))
    return (get("local", os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), L),
            get("cloud", f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}", C))


def plan_slugs(src, dst):
    return sorted(p for p, (mt, sz, lk) in src.items()
                  if p not in dst or mt > dst[p][0] + SKEW)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transfer
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def feed(pipe, data):
    try:
        pipe.write(data)
    finally:
        pipe.close()


def transfer(names, src_side, src_root, dst_root, keep_newer=True):
    """tar the listed files from src_root into dst_root on the other side."""
    data = ("\0".join(names) + "\0").encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
    # posix format keeps sub-second mtimes; the default gnu format truncates to
    # whole seconds, which made a copy look older than its source.
    tar_c = ["tar", "-C", src_root, "--format=posix", "--null", "--no-recursion", "-T", "-",
             "--ignore-failed-read", "--warning=no-file-changed", "-cpf", "-"]
    # keep_newer: a file that grew newer since the scan (a live Claude session
    # appending, an app writing) is left alone rather than rolled back. Forced
    # files — uncommitted edits — skip it: they must cross even when the other
    # side's copy is newer (a checkout there refreshed its mtime), and on
    # 2026-09-21 this flag silently vetoed exactly that.
    tar_x = ["tar", "-C", dst_root, "-xpf", "-"]
    if keep_newer:
        tar_x[3:3] = ["--keep-newer-files", "--warning=no-ignore-newer"]
    q = lambda a: " ".join(shlex.quote(x) for x in a)
    if src_side == "local":
        p1 = subprocess.Popen(tar_c, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        p2 = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-3", "-T0"], stdin=p1.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        p3 = subprocess.Popen(SSH + [REMOTE, f"mkdir -p {shlex.quote(dst_root)} && zstd -q -d | {q(tar_x)}"],
                              stdin=p2.stdout, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    else:
        os.makedirs(dst_root, exist_ok=True)
        p1 = subprocess.Popen(SSH + [REMOTE, f"{q(tar_c)} | zstd -q -3 -T0"],
                              stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        p2 = subprocess.Popen(["zstd", "-q", "-d"], stdin=p1.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        p3 = subprocess.Popen(tar_x, stdin=p2.stdout, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    p1.stdout.close(); p2.stdout.close()
    t = threading.Thread(target=feed, args=(p1.stdin, data)); t.start()
    err = p3.communicate()[1]
    t.join(); p1.wait(); p2.wait()
    if p3.returncode not in (0, 1):
        msg = err.decode(errors="replace").strip()
        print(f"      ! some files could not be written: {msg[-400:]}")
        if "Permission denied" in msg or "File exists" in msg:
            print(f"        (usually a folder a container created as another user — "
                  f"find {shlex.quote(dst_root)} -not -user $USER)")
        return False
    return True

# Git phase
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def blocked_hint(res, where):
    if res.get("blocked_dirs") and where == "laptop":
        dirs = " ".join(shlex.quote(d) for d in res["blocked_dirs"])
        print(f"     grant yourself write access, keeping the owner:  "
              f"sudo setfacl -R -m u:$USER:rwX -m d:u:$USER:rwX {dirs}")
    for d in res.get("differ", [])[:5]:
        print(f"       differs: {d}")


def report_ff(name, where, old, new, cnt, res):
    arrow = "→" if where == "cloud" else "←"
    if res.get("cleared"):
        print(f"     {name:<42} cleared {res['cleared']} untracked copy(ies) identical to the "
              f"incoming commits (archived: {res['backup']})")
    if res["ok"]:
        print(f"   {arrow} {name:<42} {where:<6} {short(old)}..{short(new)}  +{cnt} commit(s)")
        return True
    print(f"   ! {name:<42} {where} fast-forward refused: {res['msg']}")
    blocked_hint(res, where)
    return False


def precheck(lr, dest_side, dest_repo, old, new):
    """Dry-run verdict for fast-forwarding dest_repo from old to new. The lists
    are computed here: after the fetch only the laptop is sure to hold both."""
    changed = [x for x in g(lr, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", old, new).stdout.split("\0") if x]
    raw = g(lr, "diff", "--raw", "-z", "--no-abbrev", "--diff-filter=A", old, new).stdout.split("\0")
    added = {raw[i + 1]: raw[i].split()[3]
             for i in range(0, len(raw) - 1, 2) if raw[i].startswith(":")}
    return helper(dest_side, {"op": "ffcheck", "repo": dest_repo},
                  stdin=json.dumps({"changed": changed, "added": added}))


def report_check(name, where, cnt, res):
    arrow = "→" if where == "cloud" else "←"
    if res["ok"]:
        extra = (f", clearing {res['clash']} untracked copy(ies) identical to it"
                 if res.get("clash") else "")
        print(f"   {arrow} {name:<42} {where} is {cnt} commit(s) behind — would fast-forward{extra}")
    else:
        print(f"   ! {name:<42} {where} fast-forward would be refused: {res['msg']}")
        blocked_hint(res, where)


def git_phase(rel, L, C, mode, dry, stamp):
    lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
    shared = sorted(set(L["repos"]) & set(C["repos"]))
    changed = False
    for r in shared:
        lr = os.path.join(lroot, r) if r else lroot
        cr = f"{croot}/{r}" if r else croot
        li, ci = L["repos"][r], C["repos"][r]
        name = label(r)
        if li["head"] == ci["head"]:
            print(f"   = {name:<42} {short(li['head'])} {li['branch']}")
            continue
        if li["branch"] != ci["branch"] or "HEAD" in (li["branch"], ci["branch"]):
            print(f"   ! {name:<42} branch laptop={li['branch']} cloud={ci['branch']} — left alone")
            continue
        url = f"ssh://{REMOTE}{cr}"
        # Fetch the cloud branch's objects without creating any ref: the scan
        # already knows the commit id, so nothing is written but objects, and a
        # dry run leaves the repo's refs, index and FETCH_HEAD untouched.
        f = g(lr, "fetch", "-q", "--no-write-fetch-head", url, f"refs/heads/{ci['branch']}")
        ch, lh = ci["head"], li["head"]
        if f.returncode != 0 or g(lr, "cat-file", "-e", f"{ch}^{{commit}}").returncode != 0:
            print(f"   ! {name:<42} fetch from cloud failed: {f.stderr.strip()[-200:]}")
            continue
        anc = lambda a, b: g(lr, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", a, b).returncode == 0
        n = lambda a, b: g(lr, "rev-list", "--count", f"{a}..{b}").stdout.strip()
        bak = f"{BACKUP_DIR}/{stamp}-{slugify(rel + '/' + r)}-untracked.tar.zst"
        if anc(ch, lh):
            cnt = n(ch, lh)
            if mode not in ("push", "sync"):
                print(f"   → {name:<42} laptop ahead by {cnt} (push/sync applies it)")
            elif dry:
                report_check(name, "cloud", cnt, precheck(lr, "cloud", cr, ch, lh))
            else:
                p = g(lr, "push", "-q", url, f"+{lh}:refs/cloudsync/incoming")
                if p.returncode != 0:
                    print(f"   ! {name:<42} push to cloud failed: {p.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
                else:
                    res = helper("cloud", {"op": "ff", "repo": cr, "ref": "refs/cloudsync/incoming",
                                           "backup": bak})
                    cloud(f"git -C {shlex.quote(cr)} update-ref -d refs/cloudsync/incoming")
                    changed |= report_ff(name, "cloud", ch, lh, cnt, res)
        elif anc(lh, ch):
            cnt = n(lh, ch)
            if mode not in ("pull", "sync"):
                print(f"   ← {name:<42} cloud ahead by {cnt} (pull/sync applies it)")
            elif dry:
                report_check(name, "laptop", cnt, precheck(lr, "local", lr, lh, ch))
            else:
                res = helper("local", {"op": "ff", "repo": lr, "ref": ch, "backup": bak})
                changed |= report_ff(name, "laptop", lh, ch, cnt, res)
        else:
            print(f"   ✗ {name:<42} DIVERGED laptop {short(lh)} / cloud {short(ch)} — merge by hand")
    for r in sorted(set(L["repos"]) - set(C["repos"])):
        print(f"   + {label(r):<42} repo only on the laptop ({short(L['repos'][r]['head'])}) — copied whole")
    for r in sorted(set(C["repos"]) - set(L["repos"])):
        print(f"   + {label(r):<42} repo only on the cloud ({short(C['repos'][r]['head'])}) — copied whole")
    return changed


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One project
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
IGNORE_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(__file__)), "cloudsync.ignore")


def central_ignores(rel):
    """Patterns from cloudsync.ignore that apply when syncing `rel` — its own
    section, a child's (when syncing a parent) or a parent's (when syncing a child)."""
    sections, cur = {}, None
    try:
        for line in open(IGNORE_FILE, encoding="utf-8"):
            line = line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                cur = line[1:-1].strip().strip("/")
                sections.setdefault(cur, [])
            elif cur is not None:
                sections[cur].append(line)
    except OSError:
        return []
    out = []
    for sec, pats in sections.items():
        if sec == rel:
            out += pats
        elif sec.startswith(rel + "/"):      # syncing a parent of the section
            sub = sec[len(rel) + 1:]
            out += [p if "/" not in p else f"{sub}/{p}" for p in pats]
        elif rel.startswith(sec + "/"):      # syncing a child of the section
            sub = rel[len(sec) + 1:] + "/"
            out += [p if "/" not in p else p[len(sub):] for p in pats
                    if "/" not in p or p.startswith(sub)]
    return out


def scan_both(rel, skip):
    lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
    fixed = DEFAULT_IGNORE + central_ignores(rel)
    base = {"op": "scan", "skip": skip, "ignore": fixed}
    L = helper("local", dict(base, root=lroot))
    C = helper("cloud", dict(base, root=croot))
    # a .cloudsync-ignore on either side applies to both
    ign = sorted(set(L["ignore"]) | set(C["ignore"]))
    if ign and (set(ign) != set(L["ignore"]) or set(ign) != set(C["ignore"])):
        L = helper("local", dict(base, root=lroot, ignore=fixed + ign))
        C = helper("cloud", dict(base, root=croot, ignore=fixed + ign))
    L["project_ignore"] = central_ignores(rel) + ign
    return L, C


def add_repo_trees(rel, S, D, side, send):
    """A repo present on one side only travels with its .git."""
    root = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel) if side == "local" else f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
    for r in sorted(set(S["repos"]) - set(D["repos"])):
        sub = f"{r}/.git" if r else ".git"
        send += sorted(helper(side, {"op": "tree", "root": root, "sub": sub}))


def show(title, names, verbose):
    if not names:
        return
    print(f"   {title}: {len(names)} file(s)")
    if verbose:
        for n in names:
            print(f"      {n}")
    else:
        groups = {}
        for n in names:
            k = n.split("/")[0] if "/" in n else "(top level)"
            groups[k] = groups.get(k, 0) + 1
        for k, v in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:8]:
            print(f"      {v:>6}  {k}")
        if len(groups) > 8:
            print(f"      … {len(groups) - 8} more folders (-v lists every file)")


def run_project(rel, mode, dry, verbose, with_deps):
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    lroot, croot = os.path.join(LOCAL_DEV, rel), f"{CLOUD_DEV}/{rel}"
    skip = [] if with_deps else DEP_DIRS
    arrow = {"sync": "⇄", "push": "→", "pull": "←"}[mode]
    print(f"\n━━ {rel}  laptop {arrow} cloud{'  (dry run)' if dry else ''}")

    L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)
    if not L["exists"] and not C["exists"]:
        die(f"'{rel}' exists on neither side")
    if L["project_ignore"]:
        print(f"   project excludes: {', '.join(L['project_ignore'])}")
    for side, root, name in (("cloud", croot, "cloud"), ("local", lroot, "laptop")):
        if (side == "cloud" and mode in ("push", "sync")) or (side == "local" and mode in ("pull", "sync")):
            run = helper(side, {"op": "running", "root": root})
            if run:
                print(f"   note: running on the {name} — {', '.join(run[:6])}{' …' if len(run) > 6 else ''}")

    print("   git:")
    if L["exists"] and C["exists"]:
        if git_phase(rel, L, C, mode, dry, stamp):
            L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)  # the fast-forwards moved files and mtimes
    shared = sorted(set(L["repos"]) & set(C["repos"]))

    lh, ch = dirty_hashes(rel, L, C)
    none = ([], [], set())
    up, up_c, up_f = plan_files(L, C, shared, lh, ch) if mode in ("push", "sync") else none
    down, down_c, down_f = plan_files(C, L, shared, ch, lh) if mode in ("pull", "sync") else none
    if mode in ("push", "sync"):
        add_repo_trees(rel, L, C, "local", up)
    if mode in ("pull", "sync"):
        add_repo_trees(rel, C, L, "cloud", down)

    base = slugify(rel)
    ls = helper("local", {"op": "slugs", "projdir": LOCAL_PROJ, "base": LOCAL_SLUG + base})
    cs = helper("cloud", {"op": "slugs", "projdir": CLOUD_PROJ, "base": CLOUD_SLUG + base})
    lmap = {s[len(LOCAL_SLUG):]: m for s, m in ls.items()}
    cmap = {s[len(CLOUD_SLUG):]: m for s, m in cs.items()}
    chat_up, chat_down = {}, {}
    for k in sorted(set(lmap) | set(cmap)):
        if mode in ("push", "sync"):
            x = plan_slugs(lmap.get(k, {}), cmap.get(k, {}))
            if x: chat_up[k] = x
        if mode in ("pull", "sync"):
            x = plan_slugs(cmap.get(k, {}), lmap.get(k, {}))
            if x: chat_down[k] = x

    print("   files:")
    if not (up or down):
        print("   (nothing to move)")
    show("laptop → cloud", up, verbose)
    show("cloud → laptop", down, verbose)
    for p, why in sorted(set(up_c + down_c)):
        print(f"   ✗ conflict: {p} — {why}")
    print("   chats + memory:")
    if not (chat_up or chat_down):
        print(f"   (in sync — {len(set(lmap) | set(cmap))} slug(s))")
    for k, v in chat_up.items():
        print(f"   → {k:<52} {len(v)} file(s)")
    for k, v in chat_down.items():
        print(f"   ← {k:<52} {len(v)} file(s)")
    if dry:
        return

    def move(names, src_side, src_root, dst_side, dst_root, D, tag, forced=()):
        if not names:
            return
        over = [n for n in names if n in D]
        if over:
            b = helper(dst_side, {"op": "backup", "root": dst_root, "days": BACKUP_DAYS,
                                  "out": f"{BACKUP_DIR}/{stamp}-{tag}.tar.zst"},
                       stdin=json.dumps(over))
            if b["path"]:
                where = "laptop" if dst_side == "local" else "cloud"
                print(f"      saved {b['archived']} replaced file(s) on the {where}: {b['path']}")
        normal = [n for n in names if n not in forced]
        must = [n for n in names if n in forced]
        ok = transfer(normal, src_side, src_root, dst_root) if normal else True
        if must:
            ok = transfer(must, src_side, src_root, dst_root, keep_newer=False) and ok
        return ok

    def envs_for(names, S, D):
        m = {}
        for n in names:
            if os.path.basename(n) == ".env" and n in S["envs"]:
                d = D["envs"].get(n)
                m[n] = {"had": n in D["files"], "compose": d["compose"] if d else None,
                        "mtime": S["files"][n][0], "hash": S["envs"][n]["hash"]}
        return m

    # envfix runs even after a partial extract: it only touches the .env files
    # whose content actually arrived.
    if up:
        fix = envs_for(up, L, C)
        move(up, "local", lroot, "cloud", croot, C["files"], slugify(rel) + "-cloud", up_f)
        if fix:
            helper("cloud", {"op": "envfix", "root": croot}, stdin=json.dumps(fix))
    if down:
        fix = envs_for(down, C, L)
        move(down, "cloud", croot, "local", lroot, L["files"], slugify(rel) + "-laptop", down_f)
        if fix:
            helper("local", {"op": "envfix", "root": lroot}, stdin=json.dumps(fix))
    for k, names in chat_up.items():
        move(names, "local", f"{LOCAL_PROJ}/{LOCAL_SLUG}{k}", "cloud",
             f"{CLOUD_PROJ}/{CLOUD_SLUG}{k}", cmap.get(k, {}), "chat-" + k + "-cloud")
    for k, names in chat_down.items():
        move(names, "cloud", f"{CLOUD_PROJ}/{CLOUD_SLUG}{k}", "local",
             f"{LOCAL_PROJ}/{LOCAL_SLUG}{k}", lmap.get(k, {}), "chat-" + k + "-laptop")

    # Verify: what is still different after the run?
    L, C = scan_both(rel, skip)
    lh, ch = dirty_hashes(rel, L, C)
    ru = plan_files(L, C, shared, lh, ch)[0] if mode in ("push", "sync") else []
    rd = plan_files(C, L, shared, ch, lh)[0] if mode in ("pull", "sync") else []
    heads = [label(r) for r in shared if L["repos"][r]["head"] != C["repos"][r]["head"]]
    left = len(ru) + len(rd)
    if left == 0 and not heads:
        print("   ✔ in sync")
    else:
        if heads:
            print(f"   ⚠ git heads still differ: {', '.join(heads)}")
        if left:
            print(f"   ⚠ {left} file(s) still differ (changed during the run?) — run it again")
            if verbose:
                for n in ru + rd:
                    print(f"      {n}")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="cloudsync", add_help=False)
    ap.add_argument("args", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("-n", "--dry-run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--with-deps", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true")
    o = ap.parse_intermixed_args()  # so `cloudsync status -v bill` works, not only `-v status bill`
    if o.help or not o.args:
        print(__doc__)
        sys.exit(0)
    if socket.gethostname() == "blackwall":
        print("cloudsync runs from the LAPTOP — the box cannot reach it through NAT.")
        sys.exit(0)

    modes = ("status", "sync", "push", "pull")
    a = list(o.args)
    if a[0] == "all":
        mode = a[1] if len(a) > 1 else "status"
        if mode not in modes:
            die(f"cloudsync all [{'|'.join(modes)}]")
        projects = all_projects()
    else:
        if a[0] in modes:
            if len(a) < 2:
                die(f"usage: cloudsync {a[0]} <project>")
            mode, projects = a[0], [resolve(x) for x in a[1:]]
        else:
            mode, projects = "sync", [resolve(x) for x in a]
    dry = o.dry_run or mode == "status"
    if mode == "status":
        mode = "sync"
    for p in projects:
        run_project(p, mode, dry, o.verbose, o.with_deps)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# External Traefik override for butlerAi (butlerdemo server, Traefik-native).

=== local .env COMPOSE ===
=== DECISIONS head ===
# ButlerAI — Decisions (V0 + V1a + V1b + V1c + V1d + V1e + V1-prod + Pixel hardware)

Locked in with the user 2026-09-21. Revisit only with explicit user approval.

1. **Backend: FastAPI (Python)** — user chose it over Bun/Node. Rationale: fast to scaffold, good enough for 1-user hub.
2. **Push transport: self-hosted WebSocket hub, no Firebase** — user refused FCM/GMS dependency. V0 = server-owned `BUTLER_PUSH_PROVIDER=ws` with a broadcast/targeted `POST /v1/triggers` fanning out to connected devices. Firebase is an OPTIONAL provider behind `services/dispatch.py` (V1-prod built: `fcm` + `webhook` branches, degraded offline when creds absent; `ws` stays default — user still refuses FCM as primary).
3. **On-device TTS in V0** — Meta's server-side TTS endpoints 404 on the current key (`/v1/audio/*`, `/v1/tts`, `/v1/voices` all 404, verified by curl 2026-09-21). Therefore the server sends text (`speak_text`, <=280 chars) and Android speaks it. Server TTS only if Meta ships it later.
4. **LLM: Meta Muse Spark via OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions`.** Verified live 2026-09-21: exactly 8 models — `muse-spark-1.1`, `1.2`, `1.2-contributor`, `1.3`, `1.3-contributor`, `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0`, `muse-image-1.0`, `sam-3.1`. Chat default `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, max tokens ~500 (`BUTLER_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS`, Settings field + `chat_max_tokens` config key). Briefs are template-first; LLM enhance is optional and OFF by default (`BUTLER_BRIEF_USE_LLM=false`) so triggers work with zero LLM spend.
5. **Voice UX: ask-first.** Every proactive trigger = short spoken brief + ETA + one question ("deal with this now?"). `yes` → voice chat session; `no` → auto-reminder (default +1h, configurable). Other actions: snooze (default 30m).
6. **Call-style UI on lockscreen.** `BriefActivity` uses `showWhenLocked` + `turnScreenOn` + full-screen intent semantics; `ACTION_CALL`-style path deferred — V0 first ships activity-over-lock, escalates to real call UI only if OEMs suppress it.
7. **All behavior dynamic config.** Precedence: baked defaults < `BUTLER_*` env < `configs` table global scope < `configs` table device scope. Redis-cached 30 s (writes publish `cfg:invalidate`; `cfg-subscriber` worker evicts on publish since V1-prod — replicas converge in ~ms). No hardcoded thresholds in code paths that matter.
8. **Docker follows milestone-core conventions** — `proxy-net`/`data-net`/`db-net` (`db` internal), named volumes, pinned majors (`postgres:17`, `redis:7`), `migrate` one-shot before `api`, `worker` on shared image, dev compose bind-mounts + 127.0.0.1 + LAN (`${DEV_LAN_HOST:-192.168.1.8}`) ports + `internal:false` overrides.
9. **Env namespacing: `BUTLER_` prefix**; dev ports offset (3101/5434/6381) to avoid clashing with milestone-core.
10. **Logging: structured JSON (structlog)** on every route/service/worker, `X-Request-ID` echo (request-id middleware mints + echoes), audit trail in `audit_events` for trigger/brief/decision/config/device/connect/ack/disconnect (disconnect audited best-effort in the WS finally block).
11. **V0 scope: server + Android client.** Android builds+runs (Gradle 8.9 + AGP 8.5.2 wrapper present; needs SDK + `local.properties`). V1c/V1d/V1e delivered the rest: DND/focus-app blocklist enforcement (`GateKnobs` + `GET /v1/device-config`), trigger sources (schedules/ICS/IMAP via `services/ingest.py`), lists (rrule/recents/upcoming), avatar overlay (`AvatarManager` + Canvas `AvatarView`). OAuth calendar/email (Google/Outlook) remain future — V1d is the self-hosted rung below OAuth.
12. **V1b voice UX: gate "yes" → ChatActivity, text wire format.** BriefActivity
    DEAL NOW posts decision `yes` then opens `ChatActivity` with the `brief_id`;

# ButlerAI — Decisions (V0 + V1a + V1b + V1c + V1d + V1e + V1-prod + Pixel hardware)

Locked in with the user 2026-09-21. Revisit only with explicit user approval.

1. **Backend: FastAPI (Python)** — user chose it over Bun/Node. Rationale: fast to scaffold, good enough for 1-user hub.
2. **Push transport: self-hosted WebSocket hub, no Firebase** — user refused FCM/GMS dependency. V0 = server-owned `BUTLER_PUSH_PROVIDER=ws` with a broadcast/targeted `POST /v1/triggers` fanning out to connected devices. Firebase is an OPTIONAL provider behind `services/dispatch.py` (V1-prod built: `fcm` + `webhook` branches, degraded offline when creds absent; `ws` stays default — user still refuses FCM as primary).
3. **On-device TTS in V0** — Meta's server-side TTS endpoints 404 on the current key (`/v1/audio/*`, `/v1/tts`, `/v1/voices` all 404, verified by curl 2026-09-21). Therefore the server sends text (`speak_text`, <=280 chars) and Android speaks it. Server TTS only if Meta ships it later.
4. **LLM: Meta Muse Spark via OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions`.** Verified live 2026-09-21: exactly 8 models — `muse-spark-1.1`, `1.2`, `1.2-contributor`, `1.3`, `1.3-contributor`, `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0`, `muse-image-1.0`, `sam-3.1`. Chat default `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, max tokens ~500 (`BUTLER_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS`, Settings field + `chat_max_tokens` config key). Briefs are template-first; LLM enhance is optional and OFF by default (`BUTLER_BRIEF_USE_LLM=false`) so triggers work with zero LLM spend.
5. **Voice UX: ask-first.** Every proactive trigger = short spoken brief + ETA + one question ("deal with this now?"). `yes` → voice chat session; `no` → auto-reminder (default +1h, configurable). Other actions: snooze (default 30m).
6. **Call-style UI on lockscreen.** `BriefActivity` uses `showWhenLocked` + `turnScreenOn` + full-screen intent semantics; `ACTION_CALL`-style path deferred — V0 first ships activity-over-lock, escalates to real call UI only if OEMs suppress it.
7. **All behavior dynamic config.** Precedence: baked defaults < `BUTLER_*` env < `configs` table global scope < `configs` table device scope. Redis-cached 30 s (writes publish `cfg:invalidate`; `cfg-subscriber` worker evicts on publish since V1-prod — replicas converge in ~ms). No hardcoded thresholds in code paths that matter.
8. **Docker follows milestone-core conventions** — `proxy-net`/`data-net`/`db-net` (`db` internal), named volumes, pinned majors (`postgres:17`, `redis:7`), `migrate` one-shot before `api`, `worker` on shared image, dev compose bind-mounts + 127.0.0.1 + LAN (`${DEV_LAN_HOST:-192.168.1.8}`) ports + `internal:false` overrides.
9. **Env namespacing: `BUTLER_` prefix**; dev ports offset (3101/5434/6381) to avoid clashing with milestone-core.
10. **Logging: structured JSON (structlog)** on every route/service/worker, `X-Request-ID` echo (request-id middleware mints + echoes), audit trail in `audit_events` for trigger/brief/decision/config/device/connect/ack/disconnect (disconnect audited best-effort in the WS finally block).
11. **V0 scope: server + Android client.** Android builds+runs (Gradle 8.9 + AGP 8.5.2 wrapper present; needs SDK + `local.properties`). V1c/V1d/V1e delivered the rest: DND/focus-app blocklist enforcement (`GateKnobs` + `GET /v1/device-config`), trigger sources (schedules/ICS/IMAP via `services/ingest.py`), lists (rrule/recents/upcoming), avatar overlay (`AvatarManager` + Canvas `AvatarView`). OAuth calendar/email (Google/Outlook) remain future — V1d is the self-hosted rung below OAuth.
12. **V1b voice UX: gate "yes" → ChatActivity, text wire format.** BriefActivity
    DEAL NOW posts decision `yes` then opens `ChatActivity` with the `brief_id`;
    chat POSTs `{brief_id, messages[]}` (on-device STT text), speaks the reply
    (on-device TTS). Mic via runtime `RECORD_AUDIO` grant; `ChatActivity`
    `showWhenLocked`/`singleTop` like the gate.
