# ============================================================================
# ButlerAI butlerdemo — PROD stack
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up`.
# Base services, Traefik-native: NO nginx edge (Traefik terminates TLS
# and proxies direct to api:8000 per the external override).
# Certs live in ./edge/certs (gitignored) — place butler.crt + butler.key
# there before first boot.
# ============================================================================

services:
  # ─── Postgres ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: butler-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE:?set DB_DATABASE in .env}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:?set DB_USERNAME in .env}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:?set DB_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - butler-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - db-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 20s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Redis ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: butler-redis
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    volumes:
      - butler-redisdata:/data
    networks:
      - data-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Migrate (one-shot, runs BEFORE api/worker) ──────────────────
  migrate:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-migrate
    env_file: .env
    command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
    networks:
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  api:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-api
    env_file: .env
    command: ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
    networks:
      - proxy-net
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - "CMD-SHELL"
        - "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz')\""
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 6
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Worker (reminder_due poller → trigger ingestor) ─────────────
  worker:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-worker
    env_file: .env
    command: ["python", "-m", "app.workers.reminder_due"]
    networks:
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Config subscriber (cfg:invalidate fan-in → instant replica converge) ──
  cfg-subscriber:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-cfg-subscriber
    env_file: .env
    command: ["python", "-m", "app.workers.cfg_subscriber"]
    networks:
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Sources (schedule/cron + ICS calendar + IMAP sweeps → ingest) ──
  sources:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-sources
    env_file: .env
    command: ["python", "-m", "app.workers.sources"]
    networks:
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

# ─── Networks: only proxy-net touches the outside world ────────────────────
networks:
  proxy-net:
  data-net:
    internal: true
  db-net:
    internal: true

  butler-pgdata:
  butler-redisdata:

      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-cfg-subscriber
    env_file: .env
    command: ["python", "-m", "app.workers.cfg_subscriber"]
    networks:
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Sources (schedule/cron + ICS calendar + IMAP sweeps → ingest) ──
  sources:
    build:
      context: ./server
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: butler-demo:latest
    container_name: butler-sources
    env_file: .env
    command: ["python", "-m", "app.workers.sources"]
    networks:
      - data-net
      - db-net
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

# ============================================================================
# ButlerAI butlerdemo — PROD stack
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up`.
# Base services copied from docker-compose.yml WITHOUT dev ports; nginx
# terminates TLS and proxies to the api. No build-context changes.
# Prod DB path: app services talk through pgbouncer (transaction mode).
# Migrate keeps the direct DSN (DDL bypasses the pooler).
# Certs live in ./edge/certs (gitignored) — place butler.crt + butler.key
# there before first boot.
# ============================================================================

services:
  # ─── Edge (TLS termination + reverse proxy) ────────────────────────
  nginx:
    image: nginx:1-alpine
    container_name: butler-nginx
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./edge/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./edge/certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    networks:
      - proxy-net
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

  # ─── Postgres ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: butler-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE:?set DB_DATABASE in .env}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:?set DB_USERNAME in .env}

# ============================================================================
# ButlerAI butlerdemo — production-shaped base stack
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `docker compose up` runs THIS file. The dev overlay is merged EXPLICITLY
# (-f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml); prod never uses it.
# Services: postgres + redis + migrate (one-shot) + api + worker + sources.
# No host ports here by design — the dev overlay exposes 127.0.0.1; prod
# fronts the api with the edge proxy (nginx, V1).
# V1 adds: pgbouncer, minio (voice clips), nginx edge, prometheus/grafana.
# ============================================================================

services:
  # ─── Postgres ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: butler-postgres

      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:?set DB_USERNAME in .env}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:?set DB_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - butler-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - db-net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 20s
